item.title: Research Projects
item.description: Argumentative Graph-RAG for Participatory Democracy, LIP6 AI & Data Science programme, with Nicolas Maudet (Multi-Agent Systems team). 2025 – in progress. Intelligent services for data catalogs, CIFRE industrial PhD partnership with Zeenea (data catalog vendor). 2023 – in progress. Table Discovery in Data Lakes, LIP6 internal project. 2023–2024. Led to HEARTS, a hypergraph-based related table search method. EIT Digital CivicBudget and Inria Technology Development Action CivicBudget, participatory budgeting platforms, with CITRIS@UC Berkeley (USA), Missions Publiques (France, coordinator), Nexus and TU Berlin (Germany).

Track chair: Software Systems track, IEEE FiCloud 2019–2022. Session chair: IEEE CIC 2017 · Inria@SiliconValley Workshop BIS 2016 · IoT and Big Data 2016. item.title: Teaching
item.description: At Paris Nanterre University, since 2022 Complete database curriculum from undergraduate to Master’s level: relational databases, business intelligence, Big Data, NoSQL and data lakes. New Master’s course: Data and Knowledge Engineering for Large Language Models (RAG and KG-RAG architectures, hybrid SQL/embedding search, knowledge graph modelling, data quality and provenance), opening 2026. Year coordinator, L3 MIAGE and dual-degree programmes, since 2023. Vice-President, Consultative Disciplinary Committee, since 2025. Guest lecturer at Télécom Paris and 3iL.
